name: std::queue<T,Container>::~queue
intro:
A destructor. 
Destructs the queue. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the queue.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Insert 2 and 7, then remove the first element.
